about.title: About Collage Studio
about.intro: Collage Studio is a free photo collage maker that runs entirely in your web browser. Add your photos, pick a layout, style it and export a high-resolution image. There is no sign-up, no watermark and no upload: your photos never leave your device.
faq.a1: Yes. Collage Studio is free to use, with no account, no watermark and no limit on the number of collages you can make.
faq.a2: No. All editing and exporting happens locally in your browser. Your photos are never sent to a server, and there is no tracking or data collection.
faq.q3: How do I make a photo collage?
faq.a3: Add several photos with the Add photos button or by dragging them onto the page. Auto-fit picks the layout that crops your photos the least. Then adjust spacing, colors, filters, text and stickers, and press Export.
faq.q4: Which formats and sizes can I export?
faq.a4: You can export PNG, JPG, WebP and PDF at up to four times the canvas size, with presets for Instagram, Stories, YouTube, Pinterest, Facebook and print sizes, or your own custom size.
faq.q5: Does it work offline and on my phone?
faq.a5: Yes. Collage Studio works on phones, tablets and desktops, and it can be installed as an app that keeps working without an internet connection.
faq.q6: Can I keep working on a collage later?
faq.a6: Your last session is restored automatically on the same device. You can also save a project file and open it again whenever you like.

page.howto.title: How to Make a Photo Collage Online for Free
page.howto.desc: Learn how to make a photo collage in five steps: add photos, auto-fit a layout, style it, add text, and export a high-resolution image. Free, no sign-up, nothing uploaded.
page.howto.h1: How to make a photo collage online
page.howto.intro: You can make a photo collage in a few minutes with Collage Studio, a free collage maker that runs in your browser. There is nothing to install, no account to create and no watermark, and your photos never leave your device.
page.howto.step1: Add your photos. Click Add photos or drag several images onto the page. You can also paste an image from the clipboard or try the sample photos first.
page.howto.step2: Let Auto-fit choose a layout. Auto-fit tests many arrangements and picks the one that crops your photos the least. To choose yourself, open the Layout tab and pick a template with 1 to 16 cells.
page.howto.step3: Adjust the layout. Drag the lines between cells to resize them, drag a photo to reposition it inside its cell, and use the swap handle to exchange two photos.
page.howto.step4: Style it. In the Style tab, change the gap, margin, corner radius, border, shadow and background. Add filters to a photo, and add text or stickers from the Extras tab.
page.howto.step5: Export. Press Export, choose PNG, JPG, WebP or PDF and a size up to four times the canvas, then download, copy or share the result.
page.howto.s1.p: Grid mode fits photos into tidy cells. Freeform mode lets you place, rotate and resize photos anywhere on the canvas for a scrapbook look, and you can switch between the two at any time.
page.howto.s2.p: All editing and exporting happens locally in your browser. Photos are never uploaded to a server, and there is no tracking. Your last session is restored automatically on the same device, and you can save a project file to continue later.
page.howto.s3.p: The editor works on phones, tablets and computers, and it can be installed as an app that keeps working offline.
page.instagram.title: Free Instagram Collage Maker: Post, Story and Reel Sizes
page.instagram.desc: Make collages for Instagram in the right size: square 1080x1080, portrait 4:5 and Story or Reel 9:16. Free, no watermark, and your photos are never uploaded.
page.instagram.intro: Collage Studio has ready-made canvas sizes for Instagram, so your collage is the right shape the first time. Pick a size, add your photos and export a sharp image, all without an account or a watermark.
page.instagram.s1.p: Choose Square 1:1 (1080x1080 px) for classic feed posts, Portrait 4:5 (1080x1350 px) for the most feed space, or Story / Reel 9:16 (1080x1920 px) for Stories and Reels. Presets for Pinterest (2:3), YouTube (16:9) and Facebook (1.91:1) are in the same menu, and you can enter any custom size.
page.instagram.s2.h: Fit many photos without cropping them away
page.instagram.s2.p: Auto-fit searches for the arrangement that crops your photos the least, so faces and details stay in frame. You can then drag the dividers to give a favorite photo more room.
page.instagram.s3.h: Style it to match your feed
page.instagram.s3.p: Use quick styles, set the gap and corner radius, choose a solid, gradient or blurred-photo background, apply filters, and add text or stickers. Export as PNG, JPG or WebP at up to four times the canvas size.
page.print.title: Photo Collage for Print: A4 and 6x4 Sizes, High Resolution
page.print.desc: Make a print-ready photo collage with A4 and 6x4 inch presets and export at up to 4x resolution as PNG, JPG or PDF. Free, private and no watermark.
page.print.intro: Collage Studio can export a collage sized for printing at home, at a photo lab or as a PDF. Everything is processed in your browser, so your original photos are never uploaded.
page.print.s1.p: The A4 portrait preset is 1240x1754 px, which is 150 dpi. Exporting at 2x gives 2480x3508 px, which is 300 dpi and suitable for a sharp A4 print. The 3:2 photo print preset (6x4 in) is 1800x1200 px, already 300 dpi.
page.print.s2.h: Export as PNG, JPG or PDF
page.print.s2.p: Export at 1x to 4x the canvas size. For a PDF you can keep the collage size or place it on an A4 or Letter page with a margin. Use PNG or high-quality JPG for photo labs.
page.print.s3.p: The editor works with a light preview, but the export re-reads your original files at full resolution, so the printed result is not limited by what you see on screen.
page.compare.title: Private Collage Maker: No Upload, No Watermark, No Sign-up
page.compare.desc: How Collage Studio differs from cloud-based collage apps: photos are processed in your browser, there is no account or watermark, and it is free and works offline.
page.compare.h1: A collage maker with no upload and no watermark
page.compare.intro: Many online collage makers upload your photos to a server, ask you to sign up, or add a watermark unless you pay. Collage Studio works differently, and this page summarizes the differences.
page.compare.row1.label: Your photos
page.compare.row1.us: Processed in your browser and never uploaded
page.compare.row2.label: Account
page.compare.row3.label: Watermark

page.compare.row6.us: PNG, JPG, WebP and PDF up to 4x the canvas size
page.compare.row6.them: Varies, often limited on free plans
page.compare.s1.p: Photos often contain faces, places and private moments. Because Collage Studio runs entirely in your browser, nothing needs to be sent anywhere, and there is no data collection or tracking.
page.compare.s2.p: The source code is public on GitHub, so you can check how the app works or run your own copy.
